name: GOV.CO
body: The portal for more than 78,000 government procedures sends an HTML body with almost no text. Most AI crawlers do not run JavaScript, so they see a title and little else.
lesson: Render the main text on the server, or prerender the start page. View source should show what a visitor reads.
summary: www.gov.co scores 78 out of 100 (C). 3 checks fail now, 16 are at risk, and 12 pass. Fix first: AI crawlers see an almost empty start page.

fix.title: AI crawlers see an almost empty start page
fix.evidence: The HTML carries 0 characters of readable text. Most AI crawlers do not run JavaScript.
fix.fix: Render the main content on the server or pre-render it at build time.

fix.title: Core Web Vitals fail for real visitors
fix.evidence: Real Chrome users over the last 28 days on this page, at the 75th percentile: Largest Contentful Paint 2.9 s (needs improvement), Interaction to Next Paint 177 ms (good), Cumulative Layout Shift 1.08 (poor). Source: Chrome UX Report through PageSpeed Insights.
fix.fix: Reserve space for images, embeds, ads, and late banners. Make the largest element arrive sooner: preload the hero image, serve it at the shown size in a modern format, and cut render-blocking scripts.

fix.title: Lighthouse scores performance 15/100 on mobile
fix.evidence: Lighthouse 13.5.0 on a simulated mid-range phone over slow 4G: Largest Contentful Paint 98.2 s, Total Blocking Time 607 ms, Cumulative Layout Shift 1.007, Speed Index 34.3 s.
fix.fix: Open PageSpeed Insights for this URL and work through its opportunities, largest savings first.

fix.title: Share cards are missing og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, twitter:card
fix.evidence: LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Slack, and X build the preview from these tags. The preview in this report shows what they would show today.
fix.fix: Add the missing Open Graph and Twitter tags to every page template.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

fix.title: The content security policy has gaps
fix.fix: Replace 'unsafe-inline' with nonces or hashes, limit hosts, and add object-src 'none' and base-uri 'self'.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 404 ms
Every page has a meta description
The sitemap matches the pages that were analyzed
